## AI content auto-publisher – contentwritinguk.com (private)
Weekdays 09:23 PKT (or /new in the RixDigi Content bot): 5 news feeds → fresh, relevant stories only (no repeats) → Gemini picks the most useful story for small businesses + the matching featured image (10 branded illustrations in the WP media library) → reads the source article → Gemini writes an original 700–950 word post (British English, facts only from the source, sources listed, AI-assisted note) + SEO title/description (Rank Math) + LinkedIn, X and Instagram drafts → saved as a WordPress DRAFT in 'AI & Automation' → Telegram card with preview link: Publish now / Rewrite / Skip; reply to replace the LinkedIn text.
Publish: WordPress post goes live → LinkedIn post on Aqib's profile (link card + image) → rows in the Content calendar sheet. Nothing goes live without Aqib's tap.
